modules.title: Herb Library
modules.subtitle: Herbs as learnable system components
modules.summary: Explore each herb as a structured object: nature, flavor, channel affinity, role, and relationship to formulas.

modules.title: Meridian Network
modules.subtitle: Body logic as routes and signal pathways
modules.summary: Meridians are presented as a living network for organizing organs, movement, surface-depth logic, and herb affinity.

modules.title: Formula Engine
modules.subtitle: Compositions, hierarchy, and intent
modules.summary: Formulas are modeled as purposeful compositions using the classical roles of monarch, minister, assistant, and envoy.

modules.title: Diagnosis Logic Map
modules.subtitle: Syndromes as system states
modules.summary: Diagnosis is framed as inference: signs, tongue, pulse, temperature, fluids, and movement combine into pattern recognition.

modules.title: Classical Text Explorer
modules.subtitle: Classics as the source code of concepts
modules.summary: Classical works become navigable anchors that connect theory, herbs, formulas, and diagnostic language.

cards.title: Ginseng
cards.summary: A core qi-tonifying herb often taught as a reference point for deficiency patterns and formula hierarchy.

cards.title: Licorice
cards.summary: Frequently used to harmonize formulas, moderate harsh properties, and connect multiple herbs into a coherent composition.

cards.title: Astragalus
cards.summary: A qi-supporting herb often associated with surface stability, upward movement, and resilience metaphors.

cards.title: Coptis
cards.summary: A bitter, cold reference herb for heat-clearing logic, especially when mapping excess heat and damp-heat states.

cards.title: Liu Wei Di Huang Wan
cards.summary: A classic six-ingredient formula often used in learning materials to illustrate yin-supporting composition logic.

cards.title: Si Jun Zi Tang
cards.summary: A clean introductory formula for understanding qi support and the monarch-minister-assistant-envoy model.

cards.title: Lung Meridian
cards.summary: A route for learning surface defense, breath, fluids, and the relationship between internal organ and exterior signals.

cards.title: Liver Meridian
cards.summary: A conceptual route for movement, constraint, emotional patterning, and smooth circulation.

cards.title: Qi Deficiency
cards.summary: A system state taught through low drive, weak transformation, and reduced resilience in the TCM model.

cards.title: Yin Deficiency
cards.summary: A state model for insufficient cooling, moistening, and anchoring qualities in classical pattern language.

cards.title: Huangdi Neijing
cards.summary: A foundational theoretical anchor for yin-yang, five phases, organs, meridians, and systemic thinking.

cards.title: Shang Han Lun
cards.summary: A classical source for staged pattern recognition and formula reasoning through changing system states.
